design_status: post-hoc exploratory after the primary Step 9.2 results; not confirmatory

interpretation_policy.multiplicity: Problem-level within-network sign-flip p-values use Holm correction across the full exploratory family.
interpretation_policy.graph_associations: Graph-level Spearman intervals are descriptive because topology family and graph properties are deliberately coupled in this controlled design.
interpretation_policy.small_samples: Topology-specific intervals contain ten independent network instances; within-network problem correlations contain only six matched K-by-uncertainty problems.
